title: BusemannFormer: Horospherical Self-Attention for Hyperbolic Graph Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.27167v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hyperbolic neural networks excel on hierarchical graph data, yet existing hyperbolic Transformers largely adapt conventional attention without explicitly exploiting the ideal boundary, a geometric structure closely tied to tree hierarchy. We propose Horospherical Self-Attention (HSA): each query selects an ideal-boundary direction and scores keys by their Busemann depth along that direction, yielding a token-to-token hyperbolic attention kernel. We establish a flat-limit connection to dot-product attention, characterize score level sets as horospheres, and bound key-side gradients. HSA is integrated into BusemannFormer, a fully hyperbolic graph Transformer, with a log-depth variant that uses query depth to modulate attention concentration. We further introduce a finite-boundary-dictionary extension supporting linear-complexity global attention. translated_title: BusemannFormer：面向双曲图Transformer的极限球自注意力
translated_abstract: 双曲神经网络在层次化图数据上表现出色，但现有的双曲Transformer大多只是对传统注意力机制进行改造，并未显式利用理想边界——这一与树形层次结构密切相关的几何结构。我们提出了极限球自注意力（Horospherical Self-Attention, HSA）：每个查询选择一个理想边界方向，并根据键沿该方向的Busemann深度进行评分，从而得到一种逐token的双曲注意力核。我们建立了HSA与点积注意力在平坦极限下的联系，将得分的水平集刻画为极限球，并给出了键侧梯度的界。HSA被集成到BusemannFormer——一个完全双曲的图Transformer中，并提供了利用查询深度调节注意力集中程度的对数深度变体。我们进一步引入了有限边界字典扩展，以支持线性复杂度的全局注意力。在层次化图和引文图上的实验表明，BusemannFormer-LD优于现有的……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了基于理想边界方向上Busemann深度的极限球自注意力（HSA），并将其构建为完全双曲的图Transformer BusemannFormer，在层次化图任务上显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Horospherical Self-Attention (HSA), which scores keys by their Busemann depth along ideal-boundary directions, and builds BusemannFormer, a fully hyperbolic graph Transformer that outperforms existing methods on hierarchical graphs.
